text.title: Optical Depth
text.declared_genre: Dark Indietronica / Dub Electronica / Cosmic Ambient Bass
text.declared_mood: Disconnected, observational → swelling intensity → unresolved, suspended
text.production_notes: Deep sub bass with gravitational weight, Dub delay throws on key words, Sparse offbeat percussion, Metallic highs early, Gradual spectral thinning, Redshift-style filter automation (highs stretching away), Expanding reverbs for scale, Wider pads in chorus without full release, Ending dense yet hollow, like a star that fades before detonation
text.vocal_notes: Intimate androgynous lead, near-whispered in verses, fragile with slight tremble, Loose doubles drifting out of sync, Distant reverbed harmonies like deep-space signals, Chorus opens but stays restrained, Subtle pitch drift on sustained notes, Final layers stack without resolving
section_names: Intro – distant hum | faint pulses | airy hiss like cosmic background
Verse 1 – minimal beat | tight low-end pulse
Chorus – wider pads | sub bass blooms | echoes stretch
Verse 2 – dub delays | more space | percussive echoes
Verse 3 – slightly denser rhythm | tension building
Chorus – fuller but unstable | harmonies drift
Chorus – layered, more intense | unresolved swell
Outro – dense echoes | low-pass closing slowly | no resolution

transcription.text: Music A stand where light arrives to light Measure it, go second hand Something passes through my frame Never settling in my hands They speak in wavelengths, I can trace Spectral lines, I recognize hydrogen Praise, shifting red Has it slips beyond my size Every complement, decays Like a photon, struts too thin By the time it reaches me It forgets where it has been I calculate the drift, the scale Still I fail to feel it land I am not the place it stays I am transit, I am a phase Every brightness bends away Before it knows my name Like expansion, pulling wide Nothing helped just carried by all the walls That should remain me Passes through unchanged Passes through unchanged Passes through unchanged They say the universe retains Every trace of what occurs Background whispers fossilite Quiet proof of what once stood So where is mine? Let lingering feel that After glow of being seen Did it thin across the span Or collapse somewhere between I rehearse Acceptance lines But they scatter When I speak Maybe I'm a dying star Core to light to hold the burn Fusion falters at the edge Nothing left to overturn Iron silence At my center No more elements to give All reactions Note to stillness Yet I'm somehow Has to live Not explosion Just a dimming Drawn out An observed retreat I am not the place It stays I am transit, I am a phase Every brightness bends away Before it knows my name Like expansion Pulling wide nothing Help just carried by all the warmth That should remain Passes through unchanged If there's gravity in me Why does nothing choose to keep? Orbit fails escape is easy Everything exceeds I can map the missing mass Trace effects I cannot grasp Something should be holding fast But it never is Never is Redshift stretching Every word Longer Finnerless to find Background glow without a source Still detected never mind I remain where signals cross Not receiving not the cause Just a distance Just a frame Still expanding All the same
